raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17, transactions dated 16/01/2026) carries txn_ts in DD/MM/YYYY format while all other batches use ISO format, so the strict cast in silver_transactions fails. Every non-ISO value starts with a day of 16 or later, so DD/MM is unambiguous, and the batch timing confirms the 16th as the transaction date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH s AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ __:__:__' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM s;"}}
